info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials XAS API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: formula
params.description: Query by formula including anonymized formula or by including wild cards. A comma delimited string list of anonymous formulas or regular formulas can also be provided.

params.name: chemsys
params.description: A comma delimited string list of chemical systems. Wildcards for unknown elements only supported for single chemsys queries

params.name: elements
params.description: Query by elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: exclude_elements
params.description: Query by excluded elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: spectrum_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of spectrum_id to query on

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from XASDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `builder_meta` `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `spectrum_name` `material_id` `spectrum_id` `last_updated` `warnings` `spectrum` `task_ids` `absorbing_element` `spectrum_type` `edge`

params.name: _sort_fields
params.description: Comma delimited fields to sort with. Prefixing '-' to a field will force a sort in descending order.
